_description: Known divergences between the Tonats'oyts (Grabar) citation numbering the engine emits and the target versification used to retrieve text. First pass: only whole-range endpoint shifts are corrected; every other divergence is flagged and served unchanged. Detection is best-effort and NOT exhaustive.
_keying: Each record is keyed on the tuple (book, start_chapter, start_verse, end_chapter, end_verse) exactly as it appears in ReadingsRefs -- never on the citation string, which a composite citation shares across two refs of which only one is flagged.
_evidence: Every record was confirmed by reading the Armenian text against the English text on the cited arak29.org page, NOT by trusting that page's KJV annotations: an unannotated row is not proof of identity (Hosea 14 is annotation-free and shifted by one). See docs/ in the working notes for the full provenance discussion.

records.note: Grabar Hosea 14 runs one verse ahead of KJV throughout (Grabar 14:1 = KJV 13:16).
records.evidence: arak29.org tHos_14 (Classical Armenian Bible, 1895 Constantinople) -- content-verified

records.note: Grabar Hosea 14 runs one verse ahead of KJV throughout (Grabar 14:1 = KJV 13:16). KJV Hosea 14 ends at v9, so the original range overshoots the chapter.

records.note: Grabar Joel 3 begins at identity (Grabar 3:1 = KJV 3:1) and ends one ahead (Grabar 3:22 = KJV 3:21); a verse merge between v12 and v18 absorbs the difference mid-chapter. Only the end shifts, and the content stays contiguous and in order. Joel 3.1-8, the companion reading, is true identity and carries no record.
records.evidence: arak29.org tJoel_3 (Classical Armenian Bible, 1895 Constantinople) -- content-verified

records.note: The Greek additions to Esther. KJV/KJVAIC carries them as the standalone book ESG, not as Esther 10; KJV Esther 10 has only 3 verses, so this range has no counterpart at these addresses.
records.evidence: arak29.org tEsther_10 and the deuterocanonical Esther pages (Classical Armenian Bible, 1895 Constantinople) -- content-verified

records.note: The doxology sits at Grabar Romans 14:24-26 but at KJV 16:25-27; KJV Romans 14 ends at v23. The reading's content is therefore not contiguous in KJV and no endpoint shift can express it.
